description: Single hardware-informed noise model for the D435i, BRIO, MID-360, ARK Flow, Pixhawk 6X Pro and H-RTK approximations. Standard deviations use SI units; RGB noise uses normalized intensity. Replace values with bench and flight calibration when hardware exists.

battery.load_model_note: Provisional configurable45W electronics idle; load_w is total hover-reference watts. Additional fixed-pitch rotor power scales cubically with measured speed relative to mass/thrust-derived hover speed. No calibrated endurance claim.
